topic: Volunteering at the Food Bank for the First Time

script.title: THE FOOD BANK SHIFT
script.scene_zh: 食物銀行 · 首次報到
script.story_hook: First day volunteering, and everything is new.
script.intro_zh: 第一天當志工，什麼都是新的。
script.welcome_en: Hey, today we're at a community food bank. Listen for first-day volunteer phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嘿，今天我們來到社區食物銀行。留意第一天報到的說法。
script.outro: And the shift is on. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 志工班就這樣開始了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: you'll get the rhythm in ten minutes
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with a shaved head, salt-and-pepper stubble, a navy plaid flannel shirt, brown khaki pants, sturdy work boots, and a broad strong build
script.char_b_description: a friendly middle-aged woman in her fifties with short curly silver-grey hair, rectangular glasses on a beaded lanyard, a red canvas apron over a denim shirt, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi there, I'm here for the morning volunteer shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɛɹ aɪm hɪɹ fɚ ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˌvɑlənˈtɪr ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我來參加早上的志工班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, welcome! I'm Rosa, the shift lead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈwɛlkəm aɪm ˈɹozə ðə ʃɪft lid/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，歡迎！我是 Rosa，這班的負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great to meet you. What do I do first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tə mi tʃu wʌt du aɪ du fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你。我先做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, sign in on this sheet, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst saɪn ɪn ɑn ðɪs ʃit ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 先在這張登記表上簽到，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, um, just my name and time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm dʒʌst maɪ neɪm ænd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，只要寫名字和時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, and your emergency contact at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ænd jɔɹ ɪˈmɝdʒənsi ˈkɑntækt ət ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 對，最後面再填緊急聯絡人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Um, is there a uniform or anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈjunəˌfɔɹm ɔɹ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。嗯，要穿制服之類的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No uniform, but we do need closed-toe shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈjunəˌfɔɹm bʌt wi du nid kloʊzd toʊ ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 不用制服，但一定要包頭的鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, closed shoes, right. I'm wearing boots.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ kloʊzd ʃuz ɹaɪt aɪm ˈwɛɹɪŋ buts/
dialogue.zh: 噢，要包頭鞋，對。我穿的是靴子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, those are great for the warehouse floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðoz ɑɹ ɡɹeɪt fɚ ðə ˈwɛɹˌhaʊs flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 完美，那對倉庫地面來說很合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. So what does the shift actually look like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ wʌt dʌz ðə ʃɪft ˈæktʃuəli lʊk laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 好。那這個班實際上要做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We pack grocery boxes for families in the neighborhood.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pæk ˈɡroʊsəɹi ˈbɑksəz fɚ ˈfæməliz ɪn ðə ˈneɪbəɹˌhʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我們幫附近的家庭打包食品箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's really nice. Where exactly do I start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈɹɪli naɪs wɛɹ ɪɡˈzæktli du aɪ stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那真好。我確切該從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can join the line, it goes down the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən dʒɔɪn ðə laɪn ɪt ɡoʊz daʊn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 你可以加入流水線，沿這張桌子排下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line, um, like an assembly line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn ʌm laɪk ən əˈsɛmbli laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 流水線，嗯，像裝配線那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. One grabs, next one bags, next seals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn ɡɹæbs nɛkst wʌn bæɡz nɛkst silz/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。一個人拿東西，下一個裝袋，再下一個封口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that sounds doable. Which part is mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt saʊndz ˈduəbəl wɪtʃ pɑɹt ɪz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，聽起來做得到。我負責哪一段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the cans, just set them in the boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑɹt wɪð ðə kænz dʒʌst sɛt ðɛm ɪn ðə ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 你先從罐頭開始，把它們放進箱子裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cans into boxes, got it. How many boxes today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kænz ˈɪntu ˈbɑksəz ɡɑɾ ɪt haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑksəz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 罐頭裝進箱子，知道了。今天有多少箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About forty, we're busy before the holiday.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈfɔɹti wɪɹ ˈbizi bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ˈhɑləˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大約四十箱，節慶前我們特別忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty, huh. Should I be moving faster?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti hʌ ʃʊd aɪ bi ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 四十箱啊。我該動作快一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, you'll get the rhythm in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ jul ɡɛt ðə ˈɹɪðəm ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 彆急，你大約十來分鐘就會抓到節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, phew. Can I ask, who gets these boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ fju kæn aɪ æsk hu ɡɛts ðiz ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 好，鬆口氣。請問一下，這些箱子最後由誰領回？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Families come to the back door and pick one up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməliz kʌm tə ðə bæk dɔɹ ænd pɪk wʌn ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 家庭會從後門進來，各自領走一箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's good, it keeps it simple and private.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɡʊd ɪt kiːps ɪt ˈsɪmpəl ænd ˈpɹaɪvət/
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好，簡單又保留隱私。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, we try to make it feel normal for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt wi tɹaɪ tə meɪk ɪt fil ˈnɔɹməl fɚ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們盡量讓對方覺得自然不尷尬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that approach, honestly. Um, where's the bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt əˈpɹoʊtʃ ˈɑnəstli ʌm wɛɹz ðə ˈbæθˌɹum/
dialogue.zh: 老實說我喜歡這種做法。嗯，洗手間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall, past the break room on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə hɔl pæst ðə bɹeɹk ɹum ɑn jɔɹ lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 沿走廊走，經過休息室就在你左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Break room, is there a lunch break here?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹeɹk ɹum ɪz ðɛɹ ə lʌntʃ bɹeɪk hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 休息室，這裡有午餐休息時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty minutes at noon, you can eat here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈθɜɹti ˈmɪnəts ət nun ju kən it hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有，中午休息三十分鐘，你可以在這裡吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. I have a sandwich in my car actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪ hæv ə ˈsænwɪdʒ ɪn maɪ kɑɹ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。我其實車上還帶了三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a fridge if you want to keep it cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə fɹɪdʒ ɪf ju wɑnt tə kip ɪt koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 那裡有冰箱，你想冰著的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do that, thanks. Do we wash hands first?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl du ðæt θæŋks du wi wɑʃ hændz fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 我拿去冰，謝謝。開工前要洗手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sink's right here, soap and paper towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɪŋks ɹaɪt hɪɹ soʊp ænd ˈpeɪpɚ ˈtaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 要，水槽就在這，有肥皂和紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Wow, this line is already moving fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt waʊ ðɪs laɪn ɪz ɔlˈɹɛdi ˈmuːvɪŋ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。哇，這條線已經動得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The regulars are quick, you'll catch up, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹɛɡjəlɚz ɑɹ kwɪk jul kætʃ ʌp doʊnt ˈwɝi/
dialogue.zh: 熟手的志工都很快，你會跟上的，彆擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that Marcus? He waves at me from the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈmɑɹkəs hi weɪvz ət mi fɹʌm ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那位是 Marcus 嗎？他在門口跟我揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the volunteer coordinator, he handles the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˌvɑlənˈtɪr koʊˈɔɹdəˌneɪtɚ hi ˈhændəlz ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那是志工統籌，他負責門口那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. So do I need to lift anything heavy?
dialogue.phonetic: /kuːl soʊ du aɪ nid tə lɪft ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那我要搬很重的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the full boxes, and only if you're comfortable.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə fʊl ˈbɑksəz ænd ˈoʊnli ɪf jʊɹ ˈkʌmftɚbəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 只有裝滿的箱子，而且你覺得沒問題才搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm fine with that, I used to move furniture.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm faɪn wɪð ðæt aɪ ˈjuzəd tə muːv ˈfɝnətʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我沒問題，我以前常搬家具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, a strong back, we love that here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ə stɹɑŋ bæk wi lʌv ðæt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，有力氣的人，我們這裡最歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, happy to help. How long is the whole shift?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈhæpi tə hɛlp haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə hoʊl ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 哈，很樂意幫忙。整個班要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hours, so you're done right around one.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈaʊɚz soʊ jʊɹ dʌn ɹaɪt əˈɹaʊnd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 三個小時，大約一點就結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, that works. Do I sign out after?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ðæt wɝks du aɪ saɪn aʊt ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一點，沒問題。結束後要簽退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same sheet, just write the time you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪm ʃit dʒʌst ɹaɪt ðə taɪm ju liːv/
dialogue.zh: 要，同一張表，寫下你離開的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Um, can I bring a friend next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizil ɪˈnʌf ʌm kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ ə frɛnd nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不難。嗯，下次我可以帶朋友一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, more hands means more boxes packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs mɔɹ hændz minz mɔɹ ˈbɑksəz pækt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，人越多，我們打包的箱子就越多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll love this. Okay, I'm ready to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːl lʌv ðɪs oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈɹɛdi tə stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 她一定會喜歡這裡。好，我準備開工了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, apron's in the bin, grab the small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt əˈpɹʌnz ɪn ðə bɪn ɡɹæb ðə smɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，圍裙在那個籃子裡，拿小號那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This small one's mine? Cool, it even fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs smɔl wʌnz maɪn kuːl ɪt ˈivən fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 這條小號是我的？剛好，竟然很合身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks good on you. Sink, sheet, then the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊks ɡʊd ɑn ju sɪŋk ʃit ðɛn ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 穿起來不錯。先去水槽、再簽表，然後到流水線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sink first, then line. Got it, here I go.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪŋk fɝst ðɛn laɪn ɡɑɾ ɪt hɪɹ aɪ ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 先洗手，再上線。明白，我去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the end spot, right near the cans.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ði ɛnd spɑt ɹaɪt nɪɹ ðə kænz/
dialogue.zh: 你站到最末端，就在罐頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is nice, everyone's so welcoming actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz naɪs ˈɛvɹiˌwʌnz soʊ ˈwɛlkəmɪŋ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 這裡感覺真好，大家都很熱情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the food bank way, glad you came by.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə fud bæŋk weɪ ɡlæd ju keɪm baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這就是食物銀行的風格，很高興你來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, um, I'll definitely be back next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ʌm aɪl ˈdɛfənətli bi bæk nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，嗯，我下個月一定再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'd love that. Now, shall we get you started?
dialogue.phonetic: /wid lʌv ðæt naʊ ʃæl wi ɡɛt ju ˈstɑɹɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我們求之不得。好，要幫你上手了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, let's do it, I feel ready now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛts du ɪt aɪ fil ˈɹɛdi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，開始吧，我現在覺得準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, and you'll feel even better after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl ænd jul fil ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，做完你還會覺得更快樂。

script.youtube_title: 【食物銀行志工初日🥫】「十分鐘就會抓到節奏」第一天報到全程聽力🎧｜聽完就會用志工英語💬｜60句沉浸式｜First Day Food Bank
script.youtube_title_en: "You'll Get the Rhythm" — A First Day Volunteering at a Community Food Bank
script.youtube_description:
「十分鐘就會抓到節奏」——第一天到食物銀行當志工，要簽到、穿包頭鞋、上流水線，還有好多第一次。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區食物銀行的倉庫裡。

你會聽到：怎麼簽到登記、包頭鞋的規定、流水線怎麼分工、把罐頭裝進箱子、午餐休息與冰箱、去哪裡洗手、誰在門口揮手，以及下次能不能帶朋友一起來。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與美國人日常短句，um、so、wow、huh、phew 這些自然語感詞通通都在。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就會記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en: "You'll get the rhythm in ten minutes" — it's your first day volunteering at a community food bank, and everything is new. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right in the warehouse. You will hear signing the sheet, the closed-toe shoe rule, joining the assembly line, packing cans, the lunch break and fridge, washing hands, who waves from the door, and asking to bring a friend next time. Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans actually use: um, so, wow, huh, phew. Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first. No memorizing needed, just listen often and it sticks. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
第一天到食物銀行當志工，要穿什麼、要做什麼、午飯在哪裡吃，全都摸不著頭緒。流水線跟得上嗎？很重的箱子要不要搬？

這一集帶大家走進社區食物銀行的倉庫，從簽到、認識包頭鞋規定、上流水線裝罐頭、問午餐休息，到準備開工，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📝 簽到：First, sign in on this sheet, right here.
👟 包頭鞋：No uniform, but we do need closed-toe shoes.
📦 流水線：Start with the cans, just set them in the boxes.
⏱️ 安心句：No rush, you'll get the rhythm in ten minutes.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、wow、phew 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這個志工的第一天走一趟，下次自己走進社區，話就會自然冒出來。

祝你也度過一個充實的志工日。
